title: Completed reindexing in the lifted integral coefficient presentation
statement: Let ell be prime and E a finite extension of Q_ell in Type u, and put d = pbcIntegralDatum ell E from [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. For every isomorphism g : T′ -> T of schemes of size u with ell invertible on the stalks of T, PurCompletedReindexingAt d g holds. For every supplied chosen Cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] ChosenCartesianSquare v p′ p g of schemes of size u, with v and g isomorphisms and ell invertible on the target of g, PurCompletedReindexingSquare d sq holds. Both predicates, with every quotient-projection, tensor, transition, limit and mate normalization retained, are those of [def-pur-completed-reindexing-data].

source.place: Constituent compatibility; extracted semilinear-exchange steps 9--11, completed reindexing specialized to the lifted coefficient presentation.

proof.text: Apply lem-pur-completed-module-section-reindexing for the section-normalized ordinary module equivalence with the actual reverse pullback. Change its functor and inverse along its literal functor equalities. A generic proved helper using Mathlib Equivalence.congrRight applies it to strict diagrams. The ordinary exactness instances give finite limit and finite colimit preservation. A separate generic proved helper using Equivalence.mapDerivedCategory gives both derived equivalences, with precisely d.pull and d.towerPull and their reverse pullbacks.

Take beta and b from lem-pur-reindexing-limit-unit-normalization. For TowerComplete K the specified completionUnit(K) is invertible by definition. Compose b inverse on the strict reduction tower with the inverse of d.pull u applied to completionUnit(K). The lemma's augmentation equality identifies its inverse with ordinaryToCompleted. Cancelling the latter pulled unit proves the second normalization equation exactly. The inverse/cancellation calculation is checked generically before substituting the completed derived functors.

The defining existsUnique characterization of reductionTowerPullbackIso supplies IsCompletedReductionPullbackComparison. The existing proved pure-tensor formula levelPullIso_tensor gives the local tensor clause, and completedReductionLevelPullbackIso_transition gives every index-arrow equation. These are exactly the remaining reduction clauses, with no additional K-flat model construction required here.

For every supplied chosen Cartesian square with v and g invertible, apply lem-pur-reindexing-ordinary-mate-sections for invertibility and the section formula. Whiskering that invertible natural transformation proves the ordinary tower mate invertible. Apply lem-pur-reindexing-derived-mate-localization for both derived invertibilities and both K-injective normalization equations. Assemble the conjunctions, specializing d to pbcIntegralDatum l E and retaining each supplied chosen Cartesian square.

lean.statement:
theorem purCompletedReductionReindexingLifted (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] :
    (∀ (T' T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T' ⟶ T) [IsIso g],
      (∀ x : T, IsUnit (l : T.presheaf.stalk x)) →
        PurCompletedReindexingAt (pbcIntegralDatum l E) g) ∧
    (∀ (X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}) (v : X' ⟶ X) (p' : X' ⟶ Y')
        (p : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y) [IsIso v] [IsIso g],
      (∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.presheaf.stalk y)) →
      ∀ sq : ChosenCartesianSquare v p' p g,
        PurCompletedReindexingSquare (pbcIntegralDatum l E) sq)
